chunks.text:
[Intro]
{frame drum alone, soft beater, swinging 6/8, then the jaw harp enters}
positive_styles: night feast in a Hun nomad camp on the steppe, 3rd century BC
large frame drum played with a soft beater, steady swinging 6/8 pulse, about 96 BPM
jaw harp (temir komuz) twanging a rhythmic drone in D
hand claps from a small crowd on the off-beats
outdoors around a crackling bonfire, close and warm, a little room of open air
joyful, intimate, rustic, not polished
D dorian
instrumental
sparse
